scope: Fixed public-input Node GameSession cadence comparison; not browser, frame performance, human difficulty/fun or retention acceptance.

negativeCases.policy: No movement, fire, Q, dash, E or repair; public idle step only. No extra time if no natural defeat.

policyChanges: Reuse the recorded v079 three-strategy navigation, frozen danger avoidance, repair, Q, dash, E and public protocol selection. Both versions use exactly the same executed policy.
Remove the immune-only fire withholding clause: active cells never make this driver stop ordinary firing to manufacture cell contribution.
Filter catalysis and unknown growth IDs before applying the unchanged per-strategy priorities. The optional primer conversion is outside this cadence matrix.
Run 35 rather than 30 cleared waves, with 900 total and 120 per-wave simulation-second budgets.
cycleLabelBoundary: Labels refer to the planned v088 wave recipe, not a claim that v087 has this cadence or that every human finds these waves hard/easy.
measurements: Per wave actual accepted damage by basic tool/protocol/ability; DPS over total combat and combat with living actors; no raw/planned damage is counted.

Combat clear duration, final scheduled birth to clear, per-role birth-to-death and first-positive-hit-to-death median/p75, peak population/HP backlog, per-two-second maximum real kills, and empty scheduled/fission waits.

Real attack commitments/resolutions/interruption, concurrent commitments, and public-step seconds inside already frozen player/tissue danger footprints; no damage is required to count a dodgeable threat.

Every accepted combat choice records actual ranks, projected stats before/after, offered identity/cap, actual rank delta and supply receipts. Milestone <=2 versus ordinary1 is separately checked for each version.

Positive accepted immuneCellId TARGET_HIT receipts, real contact and LOS at receipt, same-tick bite-log join, unique targets/kills, target distance at accepted Q and at hit, and long-range accepted commands (>=360 world units). Commands are denominators, never damage.
Every actual defeat retains the game's exact reason, terminal HP/tissue/infection and recent damage/cast receipts. Budget stops/errors remain distinct from game defeat.
technicalAcceptance: No state injection: only start, step, chooseDraft (including its offered replacement), chooseCombatUpgrade, cancelResearch and resume. All sources and policies are frozen before their version's first case and unchanged afterward.

No hidden duplicate births/clears or accepted upgrade IDs; completed public-step live/reserved population <=24, fission parents <=4, total commitments <=3 and each heavy commitment <=1. Every accepted cell hit must be an actual positive HP-loss receipt with a real cell/contact/LOS and matching bite log.

Every accepted growth choice changes at least one real projected combat stat and reaches its offered actual next rank. Baseline ordinary/milestone delta1; candidate ordinary delta1 and every fifth wave min(2, remaining cap).
The predetermined candidate71 immune replay must have identical raw JSON bytes. Failure to clear is not masked or replaced.
cycleEvidenceCriteria: Report all within-generation pressure1->release2 and pressure3->release4 pairs. A measured release contrast requires at least three comparable ordinary bodies in both waves and either >=15% shorter median engaged TTK or >=15% shorter active-combat seconds per real kill; retain both values and composition differences. This is a predeclared observable proxy, not a human fun score.

Report renewed challenge at release4->elite5 and prior elite5->next pressure1 as separate window classes using raw danger-footprint seconds, actual commitments and HP backlog. A renewal observation requires a greater nonzero commitment count or greater nonzero danger-footprint duration; HP growth alone is not renewal evidence. Wave5->6 is next-generation pressure, never a release label.

Candidate cycle support is reported per run: at least two complete measured release contrasts and at least two renewal observations across different five-wave generations beyond wave5. Missing, failed or counter-dominated cases remain missing rather than averaged away.

Immune improvement requires positive accepted distant-target contribution, not a Q count. Compare exact contribution, time-to-first-bite, command success denominators and ordinary firing input under the same fixed policy; zero or non-improvement remains visible.

Do not force use of2/Q, a minimum damage taken, enemy survival until a companion action, fixed run length, or a win. Natural failures need causal receipts; if none occur, failure-explanation runtime coverage is unobserved.
